title: AIAS Engineering System and AES Standards Registry
purpose: Complete the institutional production system and make the initial AIAS Engineering Standards machine-verifiable.
scope: Operating loop, accountable offices, engineering-asset lifecycle, mandatory evidence, professional boundary, normative standards, verification and review cycles.

requirements.title: Engineering operating system
requirements.statement: The system shall define the observe-to-learn production loop, accountable offices and asset lifecycle.
requirements.rationale: Create a durable digital engineering company operating model.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Mandatory evidence
requirements.statement: Every engineering asset lifecycle shall require specification, design, verification, release and feedback evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: AES registry
requirements.statement: The system shall maintain versioned standards with owners, normative rules, verification and review cycles.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Executable validation
requirements.statement: The system shall reject incomplete, duplicated, unowned or unverifiable standards.
requirements.rationale: Turn governance into an executable control.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Professional boundary
requirements.statement: The system shall reserve regulated approval for the responsible licensed professional.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible distribution
requirements.statement: The system shall provide tests, documentation, manifest, checksums and installer.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
